t: Housing blocks are the building blocks of the Turbine.$(br2)They are required to construct its frame, support the $(l:bigreactors/rotor)Rotor$(/l), and are also used to craft the other parts. Housing blocks can fill the faces of the Turbine if you prefer not to use glass.$(br2)You will craft a lot of them.
机壳方块是涡轮机的基础构件。$(br2)它们既是搭建框架所必需的，也用于支撑$(l:bigreactors/rotor)转子$(/l)，同时还用于合成其他部件。如果你不想使用玻璃，也可以用机壳方块填充涡轮机的各个面。$(br2)你会合成很多这类方块。
$(l)Mandatory:$() they are required to build the frame and the $(l:bigreactors:turbine/rotor)Rotor$(/l)$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any$(br)$(l)Variants:$() all$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() no
